technology.title: Rim Technology
technology.intro: The rim is the rotating mass furthest from the center. Its weight, aerodynamics, and width directly define the riding character: responsiveness, comfort, and speed.

shallow.title: Shallow Depth
shallow.body: Minimized rotational weight for instant acceleration and climbing efficiency. Less affected by crosswinds.

aero.title: Aero Depth
aero.body: Maximizes aerodynamic advantage by smoothing airflow. Maintains momentum at high speeds (35km/h+).
aero.bestFor: Best for: Flats, Racing, Time Trials

internalWidth.title: Internal Width (ID)
internalWidth.body: Determines the tire shape. Wider ID (e.g., 21mm+) allows tires to balloon properly, creating a wider contact patch, lower rolling resistance, and better grip.

externalWidth.title: External Width (OD)
externalWidth.body: Should ideally be slightly wider than the tire (Rule of 105%) for optimal straight-line aerodynamics.

trend.label: Trend
trend.body: Modern road rims are moving towards 21-25mm ID to optimize 28mm-32mm tires.

widthImage.alt: Rim width and hookless profile explanation
widthImage.caption: Modern Rim Profiles

hooked.title: Hooked (Crotchet)
hooked.body: Traditional design with bead hooks. Compatible with almost all clincher and tubeless tires. High pressure tolerance.

hookless.title: Hookless (TSS)
hookless.body: Modern straight-wall design. Lighter, stronger rim wall, and a more aerodynamic transition to the tire.
hookless.note: Requires Tubeless-Ready Tires & Max 73 PSI (5.0 bar).

bedRows.undrilled: No spoke access holes in rim bed.

choose.cautionBody: Strongly not recommended to use low-end wire bead tires because of potential rim damage. High-end wire bead tires may differ, but caution is advised.

symmetrical.title: Symmetrical (Default 1:1)
symmetrical.body: Most stable load distribution. Recommended standard option.

asymmetrical.title: Asymmetrical (e.g., 2:1)
asymmetrical.body: Requires specific hub compatibility. Custom option (CAD drawing needed). Please contact support.

withDrain.title: With Drain Holes
withDrain.body: Recommended for frequent wet or rainy riding conditions.

withoutDrain.title: Without Drain Holes
withoutDrain.body: Suitable for dry environments. Reduces extra drilling.

presta.title: Presta Valve
items: All our rims default to Presta.
presta.note: Tubeless profiles may make installing certain wire bead tires difficult. Caution advised.

schrader.title: Schrader Valve
items: Rarely used in high-end performance rims.

drillingRisk.title: Incorrect Drilling Angle
drillingRisk.body: May cause uneven spoke tension and increase breakage risk.
drillingRisk.confirmation: Our rims are drilled precisely according to hub specifications.

closedBed.title: Closed Tubeless Rim Bed
closedBed.body: More difficult to assemble. Requires professional tools/experience. We recommend professional installation or our pre-nipple installation service.
